name: sw-umbrella-el-01
prompt: Wistful, magical night-time instrumental: music box and felt piano over soft warm strings and gentle pizzicato, a soft brushed texture like light rain. A sweet music-box hook in the very first second, a warm hopeful swell in the middle as if something is set free, then it settles back into the opening phrase so it loops. 80 BPM, major key with a bittersweet turn. Mellow and warm, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: sw-windpost-el-01
prompt: Tender, nostalgic instrumental waltz in 3/4: solo felt piano with soft accordion and warm cello, airy and drifting like paper on the wind. A gentle melodic hook in the first second, a warm emotional lift around the middle, then it returns to the opening phrase so it loops. Bittersweet, romantic, mellow, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: sw-snowhour-el-01
prompt: Hushed, romantic winter instrumental: celesta and soft glockenspiel over warm felt piano and upright bass, slow brushed drums. Feels like walking someone home through falling snow at night. A sparkling hook in the first second, a warm lift in the middle, gentle ending that flows back to the start. 76 BPM, major key. Soft and warm, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: sw-lasttrain-el-01
prompt: Gentle, bittersweet travelling instrumental for a rainy autumn night: fingerpicked nylon guitar over a soft brushed shuffle that feels like a slow train, warm Rhodes and light strings. A clear melodic hook in the first second, a tender swell in the second half, ends on the opening phrase so it loops. 88 BPM, major key with a wistful minor turn. Mellow, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: sw-warmjar-el-01
prompt: Warm, golden late-summer evening instrumental: soft ukulele and nylon guitar, a mellow muted flugelhorn melody, warm upright bass, soft shaker like distant crickets. Cosy, nostalgic and quietly joyful. A sweet hook in the first second, a sunny lift in the middle, ends back on the opening phrase so it loops. 84 BPM, major key. Mellow and warm, no harsh highs, no vocals.

name: sw-fog-el-01
prompt: Calm, dreamy, softly mysterious instrumental: felt piano and warm low clarinet over airy pads, a slow deep foghorn-like swell underneath, a tiny playful pizzicato motif. Cosy and gently witty, like a quiet day off by the sea. A hook in the first second, a soft lift in the middle, ends on the opening phrase so it loops. 72 BPM, major key. Mellow, no harsh highs, no vocals.
